# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 0.x     | Supported (dev releases) |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

If you discover a security vulnerability in OpenNX, please report it privately by opening a draft security advisory at:

https://github.com/Kumpelo/opennx/security/advisories/new

Do **not** open a public issue. We will respond within 72 hours and work with you to resolve the issue before disclosure.
